تبادلت (form VI)
# تَبَادَلْتُ (tabādaltu) /ta.baː.dal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
# تَبَادَلْتَ (tabādalta) /ta.baː.dal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
# تَبَادَلْتِ (tabādalti) /ta.baː.dal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَادَلَ (tabādala)
# تَبَادَلَتْ (tabādalat) /ta.baː.da.lat/: third-person fem
